## Interests

My research is in **geometric analysis**: I study how geometric
conditions -- namely curvature constraints -- on a Riemannian manifold influence analytic
properties of differential operators.

## Current Research

My doctoral work concerns estimates for the bottom of the
spectrum of the Laplacian under integral Ricci curvature
bounds. This work explores how curvature information, even
when controlled in an integral sense, can constrain spectral
properties.

## Publications

- *[Bottom Spectrum Estimate Under Curvature
  Integrability Condition](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2506.23997)*
